arguments.value: User is asking why a Flask/Jinja template can show plugin.nom in a normal loop but not in a <select> dropdown. They provide app.py, a PluginCollection iterable, and a plugin class. Likely issue is with the iterator state being consumed once and not reset, so the second loop gets no items; also template/loop over the collection vs dropdown rendering, and a possible template typo render_template("index.html.html").
